name: manual_488290
claim: Before characterizing GossipBus board state (stale claims, FAILED rows, 'orphaned' work), read the board's own log for a prior reconciliation and look for the work's successor tracker. Claims held by dead agents are released with heartbeat cleanup after confirming with the operator; FAILED rows with exhausted retries are often correct terminal records of superseded or malformed-dependency rows; old queue IDs may have evolved into a different tracker (consolidated-plan lanes and generations). Map old IDs to the successor and complete only what the successor shows done.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-18 board pass: 71 agents, 1 live, 10 M1 claims held by dead agents. My first report told the operator three FAILED rows needed a retry-or-abandon decision; a log read then showed kimi-for-coding had terminal-closed all three on 2026-09-11 with reasons (malformed depends_on, superseded by corrected rows, PT PR #241 merged), and the board note was corrected. The 10 M1-QUALIFICATION-GROUNDWORK tasks had no code trace in the repos searched because the work had moved to cross-repo PRs tracked in a dated consolidated plan; only M1-Q4b was completed (the plan showed it done) and M1-D1 (ADR-71) was the one true orphan. Repo-only searches cannot see work tracked elsewhere.
